description: Every text the native side rejects a command with, or logs for a command without a promise: one sentence per case, the values in single quotes, {name} for a parameter. scripts/contract.mjs makes ios/Contract/ANNErrorTexts.{h,mm} and android/.../react/ErrorTexts.kt from it; `platforms` limits a text to one platform.

texts.name: screenNotShown
texts.text: the screen '{componentId}' is not shown

texts.name: notInStack
texts.text: the screen '{componentId}' is not in a stack

texts.name: firstScreenOfStack
texts.text: the screen '{componentId}' is the first screen of its stack

texts.name: notInThisStack
texts.text: the screen '{componentId}' is not in this stack

texts.name: notInModal
texts.text: the screen '{componentId}' is not in a modal

texts.name: notInOverlay
texts.text: the screen '{componentId}' is not in an overlay

texts.name: notInSplitView
texts.text: the screen '{componentId}' is not in a split view

texts.name: neitherSplitViewNorStack
texts.text: the screen '{componentId}' is neither in a split view nor in a stack

texts.name: noSuchColumn
texts.text: the split view of the screen '{componentId}' has no '{column}' column

texts.name: columnIsStack
texts.text: the '{column}' column of the split view of the screen '{componentId}' is a stack: it takes a screen, not a stack

texts.name: columnNotStack
texts.text: the '{column}' column of the split view of the screen '{componentId}' is not a stack

texts.name: noScreensForStack
texts.text: there are no screens to put in the stack of the screen '{componentId}'

texts.name: alreadyShown
texts.text: the screen '{componentId}' shows already: an id goes to one screen

texts.name: setRootReplaced
texts.text: setRoot was replaced by a newer setRoot before the root '{rootId}' finished showing

texts.name: rootDestroyed
texts.text: the root '{rootId}' was destroyed before it showed

texts.name: modalWithoutRoot
texts.text: the modal '{componentId}' can't be dismissed: there is no root under it

texts.name: nowhereToShow
texts.text: the navigation has nowhere to show screens: the app has no activity or window

texts.name: nativeScreenNotRegistered
texts.text: no native screen is registered as '{name}'

texts.name: nativeScreenNotCreated
texts.text: the native screen '{name}' could not be created: its creator returned nothing

texts.name: nativeCallReloaded
texts.text: JavaScript reloaded before the call '{name}' of the screen '{componentId}' was answered
texts.doc: The error of a call of a native screen whose JavaScript reloaded before it answered.

texts.name: nativeCallNotRunning
texts.text: the navigation is not running: the call '{name}' of the screen '{componentId}' can't be answered
texts.doc: The error of a call of a native screen while no JavaScript can answer it.

texts.name: unknownNodeType
texts.text: the layout has a node of unknown type '{type}'

texts.name: nodeWithoutId
texts.text: the layout has a node of type '{type}' without an id

texts.name: sideMenuChild
texts.text: the side menu '{menuId}' has a child of type '{type}': it takes SideMenuLeft, SideMenuCenter and SideMenuRight

texts.name: stackTakesScreens
texts.text: the stack '{stackId}' takes screens, not a '{type}'

texts.name: emptyStack
texts.text: the stack '{stackId}' has no screens

texts.name: emptyTabs
texts.text: the tabs '{tabsId}' have no tabs

texts.name: tooManyTabs
texts.text: the tabs '{tabsId}' have {count} tabs: Android shows at most 5
texts.doc: Only Android checks it: its tab bar shows at most 5 tabs.

texts.name: splitViewColumns
texts.text: the split view '{splitViewId}' needs its primary and its secondary column

texts.name: pairUnsupported
texts.text: the pair '{pairId}' needs iOS 27.1 and an app built with its SDK
texts.doc: Only iOS checks it: Android has pairs on every version.

texts.name: pairNeedsTwoScreens
texts.text: the pair '{pairId}' needs two screens: its primary and its secondary

texts.name: nodeWithoutName
texts.text: the layout has a node '{nodeId}' of type '{type}' without a name

texts.name: rootMissing
texts.text: the layout of setRoot has no root

texts.name: tabsInTabs
texts.text: the tabs '{tabsId}' have a tab of type 'BottomTabs': tabs don't go inside tabs

texts.name: sideMenuSides
texts.text: the side menu '{menuId}' takes one SideMenuCenter and at most one SideMenuLeft and one SideMenuRight

texts.name: sideChildCount
texts.text: the side '{sideId}' of the side menu '{menuId}' needs exactly one child

texts.name: sideMenuInSide
texts.text: the side menu '{menuId}' has a side menu in a side: a side menu doesn't go inside a side menu

texts.name: sideOutsideMenu
texts.text: the layout has a node '{nodeId}' of type '{type}' outside a side menu

texts.name: splitViewInColumn
texts.text: the split view '{splitViewId}' has a column of type 'SplitView': a split view doesn't go inside a split view

texts.name: idGivenTwice
texts.text: the layout gives the id '{nodeId}' to two nodes

texts.name: unreadableOption
texts.text: the option '{path}' of the screen '{componentId}' has a value the navigation can't read

texts.name: unreadableDefaultOption
texts.text: the option '{path}' of the default options has a value the navigation can't read
texts.doc: An unreadable value of `setDefaultOptions`: the default options belong to no screen.

texts.name: previewGone
texts.text: the preview '{previewId}' went without being opened

texts.name: couldNot
texts.text: could not {what}: {reason}
texts.doc: Any other failure: what could not be done and why, `could not <what>: <reason>`.

texts.name: notDoneYet
texts.text: could not run '{method}': the native core doesn't do it yet
texts.doc: A command whose part of the native core is not written yet.

texts.name: notAnswered
texts.text: could not run '{method}': the native core let it go without an answer
texts.doc: A command that nothing in the native core answered: what took it let it go, or nothing took it.
